entries.title: Psalms 142:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Knowest - So as to direct me to it. My path - What paths I should chuse whereby I might escape.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Right - hand - The place where the patron or assistant used to stand.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Prison - Set me at liberty. Compass - Shall flock to me from all parts, to rejoice and bless God with me and for me. CHAPT.143 David complains and prays for pardon and help, ver. 1 - 12. A psalm of David.
